sourceModel.description: The flight-control law, ground-contact geometry and aerodynamic coefficient tables are derived from the upstream JSBSim F-16A baseline.

derivations.method: first-order scale of the upstream F-16 baseline by public empty-mass, span and length ratios
unit conversion from the published M88 specific-fuel-consumption values

knownLimitations: Aerodynamic coefficient tables are inherited from the F-16 baseline and are not Rafale-specific.
The flight-control law is a generic fighter fly-by-wire baseline, not the Rafale control law.
Landing-gear positions and external-store modelling remain inherited or unsupported.
The 45.7 square metre wing reference area comes from an open secondary technical reference rather than the manufacturer specification page.
This model is not certified, validated or representative of classified aircraft data.

excludedSources.name: Historical FlightGear Rafale B addon
excludedSources.reason: The author requested removal and redistribution must not be assumed. No content from that addon is used.
